listing.summary: This mod is an attempt to expand upon the current game without changing the basic dynamics.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 37 new ships, new weapons, and new starting ships without changing basic game dynamics or adding new factions.

description:
Download link:

http://199.91.152.146/123mkbawz8ug/i8xclqx225n4bam/Starfarer+Plus+1.021.rar

Description:

This mod is an attempt to expand upon the current game without changing the basic dynamics. There are 37 new ships, a few new weapons, new starting ships, and no new factions. It is still a beta and I will continue balancing ships as issues arise.

Please; do not be afraid to give suggestions this is supposed to be a vanilla friendly mod!

Installation

Extract plus folder from the zip into the mods folder (-/Fractal Softworks/Starfarer/mods/). Start the game, click "Mods" at the bottom of the launcher pop-up, and enable Starfarer Plus. Play the game!

Change Log

V 1.021

Balenced ships pricing and stats also changed starter ships.

V 1.02

Added 3 new ships and fixed the corvettes.

V 1.01

-Added 6 new ships.

-Balanced some old ships. It should be more vanilla friendly now.

FAQ

Is this mod compatible with Omega's Minimash?

-No Omega's Minimash already contains these ships or soon will.

Is this mod compatible with other mods?

-Yes; most. If incompatibility is found I will attempt to fix.

Will you be adding new ships?

-Yes as new sprites are made that fit the game style

Will you adding more weapons?

-Yes there are plenty of holes to fill.

Credits

This mod has been made with the help of DeathSG, medikohl, and Durendal5150.

-Spiral Arms ships. (

http://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=1131.0

)
